messages:
alice.chen: Scheduling Nimbus Systems PRIVATE rollout for Mon 2026-05-04 02:00 UTC, 4h change window. Need final signoffs (security, infra, ops, PM). Plan: pin model to `nimbus-llama-2.3-q8`, canary at 5% for first 30m, then ramp to 100% over 45m if healthy. Rollback criteria: >3% 5xx OR p99 latency >1.5s sustained for 10m. Release notes: https://redwood.app/releases/nimbus-2026-05-04 — please ack with :white_check_mark: and call out any blockers.

deploy-bot: preflight summary:
- infra: capacity OK (reserved pool 12 GPUs)
- image: `infra/nimbus-deploy@sha256:7a1c9e`
- model artifact: `nimbus-llama-2.3-q8` (sha: b3f2c4)
- canary policy: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 15m -> 100%
- monitoring hooks: datadog dashboard linked
- kms: key rotation scheduled but NOT confirmed by security
- certs: expiring cert on node group A in 6d (no impact now)

bob.rivera: infra ack. autoscaler and pool sizing validated. verified warm KV cache on canary nodes. :thumbsup:

carla: quick question — fallback model? if we rollback we should route to `nimbus-llama-2.2-fp16` (compatible runtime). Confirming that variant is loaded in the private pool.

erin_ops: monitoring & smoke tests ready.
Datadog dash: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/nimbus/rollout
I'll run smoke flows after the 5% canary spin-up. Alert thresholds set:
- p95 > 0.8s -> warning
- p99 > 1.5s -> critical
- error rate 2xx->5xx delta > 2% -> warning

frank_pm: customer comms are scheduled (T-48h email + maintenance notice). Release notes updated. One ask: we saw a payload parsing error in sandbox for a specific prompt shape — ops, please verify the prompt schema test in the smoke run.

sec-bot: Security checklist:
- KMS policy present but key rotation needs execution at 01:30 UTC pre-deploy
- Audit log retention configured to 365d
- HSM integration verified in staging only; private prod needs HSM activation toggle (engineering to flip)
Pending: KMS rotation + HSM toggle -> security signoff required

dan.oneil: can we reduce canary to 3% and extend to 45m? Nimbus is sensitive and customer asked for conservative ramp. Also recommend setting a temporary traffic cap per-tenant in the first hour.

alice.chen: dan — proposal noted. Ops prefers 5% x30m for quicker signal, but ok to keep conservative for Nimbus. Compromise: start at 5% x30m, if metrics noisy extend to 45m automatically. We'll enable per-tenant cap 200 req/min for first 60m. Adding that to rollout config below.

alice.chen: rollout config snippet:
```
rollout:
  model: "nimbus-llama-2.3-q8"
  canary:
    percent: 5
    duration_minutes: 30
    extend_on_alert: true
  fallback_model: "nimbus-llama-2.2-fp16"
  tenant_caps: 200
  rollback_conditions:
    - type: error_rate
      threshold_percent: 3
      window_minutes: 10
    - type: p99_latency
      threshold_ms: 1500
      window_minutes: 10
```

bob.rivera: noted. cert rotation for node group A is tracked in infra ticket #IR-9845, no impact to this window if we rotate at T-30.

carla: fallback artifact available and warmed. Confirming runtime compatibility and KV prepopulated.

erin_ops: smoke script (post-canary):
```
curl -X POST https://private-nimbus.api/test -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test: ping"}'
```
I will run it at canary start + 10m and after ramp to 25%.

frank_pm: confirmed customer is OK with per-tenant cap. Good to go from PM side. :rocket:

sec-bot: executing key rotation scheduled at 2026-05-04T01:30:00Z. Will report status here within 10m of completion.

deploy-bot: deploy job scheduled by alice.chen
- run_id: rb-20260504-0912
- commit: 6f9d2a1
- scheduled_start: 2026-05-04T02:00:00Z
- pinned_model: nimbus-llama-2.3-q8
- canary: 5% x30m

dan.oneil: ack. I'll be on-call during the window.

alice.chen: requesting final explicit GO from security & ops before we flip schedule to live. Reply with "GO" to approve.

sec-bot: GO — key rotation completed successfully. :white_check_mark:

erin_ops: GO — monitoring hooks are live, smoke tests ready, will be in channel during canary.

bob.rivera: GO from infra. Autoscaler policy set and warm nodes online.

carla: GO — fallback warm and config pinned.

frank_pm: GO — customer comms sent.

alice.chen: All signoffs received. Marking rollout as APPROVED. I'll start the pre-deploy checklist at 2026-05-04T01:40Z (HSM toggle + final KV warm). Good luck team — keep this thread for live updates and quick rollback decisions. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy status: SCHEDULED -> start 2026-05-04T02:00:00Z (UTC). Notify channel when canary is live.
